HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

3. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   B. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

7. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

8. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
